maximum_attempt_runtime_rule: ceil(remaining source milliseconds/1000)+120 seconds; source time, not startup/calendar time, completes the target.
snapshot_delta_correction: Official books documentation specifies400 levels in the initial snapshot and incremental changes every100ms. A change list is not the standing book.

start_gate: Signed new freeze; passing exact-head push and PR CI;39 private offline checks passed locally and on Apollo;54 prior closed hashes and excluded-tail hash checked on both hosts; actual Apollo-to-desktop simulated-failure alert acknowledged by the desktop server; local alert service kill/restart verified; no existing collector.
retry_policy: At most3 new attempts total, including the initial new attempt, inside one48-hour BOOTTIME-bounded campaign. Earlier attempts001–003 are preserved separately, not reused as live attempts.

Only explicit transport disconnects/receive timeouts and public handshake HTTP500/502/503/504 are retryable. TLS/certificate, authentication/entitlement/regional/access, validation/sequence/clock/storage, byte/runtime bounds and unknown/internal faults stop and alert.

Each new attempt has exclusive files, an independent snapshot/sequence chain and its own1.5GB serialized-data cap. Seal/read/hash/CRC/protocol/coverage-audit a transport-stopped prefix before carrying its eligible time. Pause30seconds before an authorized next attempt.
No automatic fourth attempt, hidden cap increase, provider/region fallback, validation relaxation, resumed failed connection, repeated48-hour period or cross-gap stitching.
monitoring: Apollo background watchdog polls/persists heartbeat and state every2seconds; it supervises only its own child recorder and queues durable failure/retry/completion events.

Worker stops if its watchdog heartbeat is older than30seconds. Parent stops a stale worker after45seconds, without blind retry. SIGINT/SIGTERM close/hash gzip; unclean SIGKILL/power/storage outcomes are never falsely sealed.

An independently restartable local user service polls Apollo read-only every15seconds. It sends persistent critical desktop failure alerts, deduplicates delivered event IDs, independently detects stale watchdog heartbeats, and warns after two failed remote polls.
No phone or external push service is active. The earlier generic scheduled phone test was not confirmed and phone notifications were explicitly declined. No further phone publishing.

Desktop notifications cannot arrive while the local computer is asleep/logged out or its notification service is unavailable. Server events persist and are delivered on wake/login. Existing SSH/YubiKey access is required; connection-loss alerts do not prove server failure.
HTML and copied local data are saved views, not browser auto-refresh or between-turn chat pushes. Notification-server acknowledgement is not confirmed human receipt.
accounting_and_limits: Count only separately bounded source spans; all startup, cleanup, suspend, unsealed tails and inter-attempt gaps contribute zero time and liquidity. Prior credit remains15,945,897ms, not retroactive acceptance of the formerly rejected final frame.

Keep each source window, source/UTC/monotonic/BOOTTIME clock and host identity. Monotonic values are not comparable across hosts. Do not fabricate sequences, warmup, pending plans, ownership, protection, financial labels, loss-latch resets or terminal sales across boundaries.

Twelve-hour time accounting is provisional until full data-quality review. Gzip CRC/hash is not native book checksum acceptance; checksum0 is unavailable. L2/trades do not establish own-order fills, queue priority, historical fee/rule identity, calibrated wire latency or profitability.

No financial replay, model call, account API, VIP/login endpoint, paid data, order, strategy/risk change, deployment or system power-policy/privilege change. A later financial study needs its own freeze.
